title: World Bank Open Data
description: Population, GDP, manufacturing value added, cereal production, employment by sector, urban share, life expectancy, tourist arrivals, electricity and internet access, R&D spending, R&D researchers, labour-force participation, arable land and military spending, country by country.

title: Natural Earth 1:50m
description: Country outlines, lakes, rivers, urban areas, populated places, ports and airports.

title: Köppen-Geiger climate classification
description: Observed 1976–2000 climate zones at 0.5°, used to place rainforest, savanna, desert, scrub, temperate and boreal forest, tundra and ice on the map.

title: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / AWS Open Data)
description: Global elevation and bathymetry (SRTM, GMTED, ETOPO1, GEBCO and others), ~10 km per pixel at zoom 4.

title: Global Power Plant Database
description: Every power plant above 30 MW with coordinates, fuel and capacity.
